title: THE NEW ATTP SUPER LEAGUE SEASON
excerpt: THE NEW ATTP SUPER LEAGUE SEASON
body_html:
The ATTP Super League 2025–2026 team table tennis tournament has got under way in Chișinău. This project, now a tradition, has opened a new eight-month season of matches between teams that bring together the best and most dedicated table tennis players in the country.

The ATTP Super League is not just a fixture list but a real sporting story, combining team spirit, strategy, intense battles and vivid emotions. Each team is a united group of players, ready to show their skill and fight throughout the season for a prestigious trophy.

The organisers point out that the ATTP Super League has already established itself as one of the most anticipated and spectacular tournaments in national table tennis. Over the eight months, fans can look forward to dozens of matches, dramatic finishes and new sporting revelations.

The season opener was the starting point for all participants — and, for spectators, an invitation to follow a contest that promises to be intense and gripping.
